intro.text: A grimy street man in T'Telir who wears fancy, worn-out clothes to mock the rich, and charges people for the right to pick through the rubbish in an alley behind two restaurants.

items.text: Cads lets Vivenna eat her fill from the rubbish for one bit. When she comes back another day with a single coin, he turns her away, saying even children manage two, and sends her off hungry though she has gone days without eating.

appearance.text: Filthy, but dressed in fine clothes gone shabby, which he wears as a joke at the expense of the well-born.
